reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and adds isNonBusinessDay, but keeps that predicate private so getDatesInRange re-implements the holiday check inline.

duplication.why: The off-day test (`isWeekend || holidays.includes(dayFromDate(date))`) exists both in isNonBusinessDay and inline in getDatesInRange's daily-skip branch.

placement.why: Holiday handling sits in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend rule; the server handler duplicate is the only misplaced piece.

scope.why: Only the weekend/holiday path, config type and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: The holiday rule is threaded by hand to each caller and the two schedule-template.ts calls to getDateWithSkippedWeekend were not given holidays, so the rule silently diverges there.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getDatesInRange (server/schedules/app.ts) checks `d.isWeekend(date) || config.holidays?.includes(...)` itself instead of using the shared non-business-day predicate.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline holiday check in getDatesInRange is a plain, recognisable copy of isNonBusinessDay.

one_place.where: Rule lives in getDateWithSkippedWeekend/isNonBusinessDay, but getDatesInRange re-decides holidays inline and schedule-template.ts's two getDateWithSkippedWeekend calls do not receive holidays.
